title: Outliers and the Hard-Margin Linear SVM in High-Dimension, Low-Sample-Size Settings
abstract: arXiv:2611.13869v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We study how outliers affect the hard-margin linear support vector machine when the dimension grows while the sample sizes remain fixed. For one-sided contamination, the centered Gram matrix converges to a constant inlier block plus an outlier-diagonal component, and the limiting dual problem has a closed-form solution. All outliers act through one effective distance. This representation yields explicit thresholds for loss of inlier support, margin shrinkage. intercept displacement, and asymptotic misclassification. We then treat contamination in both classes. The limiting intercept is the multiplier of the class-balance constraint, and the two classes pull it in opposite directions. Consequently, at most one class can collapse or be asymptotically misclassified, whereas symmetric contamination leaves the limiting discriminant function unchanged even though the margin shrinks. translated_title: 高维小样本设置中的离群点与硬间隔线性支持向量机
translated_abstract: 我们研究了当维度增长而样本量保持固定时，离群点如何影响硬间隔线性支持向量机。对于单侧污染情形，中心化Gram矩阵收敛为一个常数内点块加上一个离群点对角分量，极限对偶问题具有闭式解，所有离群点均通过一个有效距离发挥作用。这一表示给出了内点支持丧失、间隔收缩、截距位移以及渐近误分类的显式阈值。随后我们研究两类数据均受污染的情形：极限截距是类别平衡约束的乘子，两个类别会将其向相反方向拉动。因此，至多只有一个类别会发生崩溃或渐近误分类；而对称污染虽然会使间隔收缩，却使极限判别函数保持不变。七个数值实验验证了对偶分配、相位……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文建立了高维小样本下离群点对硬间隔线性SVM影响的精确渐近理论：单侧离群点的全部效应可归结为一个有效距离并由此导出内点支持丧失、间隔收缩、截距位移和误分类的显式阈值，而两类对称污染仅收缩间隔、不改变极限判别函数。
en_tdlr: This paper shows that in high-dimension, low-sample-size settings, all one-sided outliers affect the hard-margin linear SVM through a single effective distance with explicit thresholds for support loss, margin shrinkage, intercept displacement, and misclassification, while symmetric contamination shrinks the margin but leaves the limiting discriminant function unchanged.
